info.title: AisleSignals Implementation API Contract
info.description: Engineering design contract, not a deployed service or a vendor API. Browser uses server sessions; companion and integration identities are separate. Tenant/site/lifecycle checks apply to all resources. Raw OIDC callbacks, provider-specific webhooks and local installer credential entry are integration surfaces documented in the implementation plan. No biometric, clinical decision or door-lock APIs.

post.description: Consume bound authorisation. Persist command and outbox atomically. Server sets expiry no later than token expiry. Gateway verifies signature, site, output, policy, expiry and stable command ID before at most one dispatch. Persist execution intent before actuation; a crash with uncertain outcome must not trigger replay. HTTP 202 does not mean a sounder operated.

DeviceConfig.description: Signed configuration for the laptop companion. Initial spool ceiling 2 GB and 24 hours, subject to a 5 GB host free-disk guard. Capture lease expires within 15 minutes. Resource overload suspends affected classes; do not move unbounded video to cloud.

Output.description: OPTION only: a documented software API to an already installed system. No new relay/wiring/device. Ordinary laptop speaker notification is the MVP notification path, not this external action interface.

frame_url.description: Same-origin session-authorised transient frame proxy; no bearer secret in URL.

state.description: Execution state; SUCCEEDED alone does not establish verified physical activation. Check physical_state.

jpeg_base64.description: Base64 JPEG, decoded size at most 1 MiB; bounded safe decode and digest checks.

SignedCommand.description: Compact JWS. Protected header requires alg ES256, kid from the signed configuration key set, typ aislesignals-command+jws. Verified payload must conform to CommandPayload; only its signed values are authoritative. Reject unrecognised keys/algorithms, external key URLs and mismatched outer command_id. Expiry is at most 10 seconds and never later than authorisation expiry.

serviceBearer.description: Scoped integration token with feed and site allowlist.

sessionCookie.description: Opaque Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session; mutation CSRF/origin validation and current application membership required.

x-invariants: Tenant and site rights come from authenticated identity, not request fields.
Device site and integration camera mappings must match all supplied IDs.
Idempotent mutation and outbox writes are transactional.
Media keys are private and current authorisation is rechecked for every read.
No AI result can issue a physical command.
Existing laptop and existing camera/software interfaces only; no hardware procurement or new relay adapter.
Unknown, stale and missing data never become proof of guilt or zero loss.
Delivery retries do not imply permission to repeat physical actuation.
